hero.title: CONQUER THE GALAXY
hero.description: Build your empire across the stars. Command fleets, colonize planets, and dominate the universe in this next-generation space strategy game.

features.title: CORE FEATURES
features.subtitle: Everything you need to build a galactic empire

colonization.title: Planetary Colonization
colonization.description: Establish colonies across hundreds of unique planets. Manage resources, build infrastructure, and expand your territory.

fleet.title: Fleet Command
fleet.description: Design and command powerful fleets. Engage in tactical battles and defend your empire from threats.

research.title: Research & Technology
research.description: Unlock advanced technologies. Upgrade your civilization and gain strategic advantages.

cazaLigero.name: Light Fighter
cazaLigero.description: A light and fast attack ship. Its low production cost allows for large swarms to overwhelm enemy defenses.

cruceroPesado.name: Heavy Cruiser
cruceroPesado.description: Almost three times more armored than a Light Fighter and with superior firepower, it's the backbone of any combat fleet.

naveCarga.name: Cargo Ship
naveCarga.description: Specifically designed for mass transport of resources between systems. It is slow and vulnerable, but its capacity is unmatched.

sondaEspionaje.name: Espionage Probe
sondaEspionaje.description: Small unmanned ship equipped with advanced sensors. Allows obtaining critical information about enemy planets.

reciclador.name: Recycler
reciclador.description: Ship specialized in collecting debris in orbits after a battle. Vital for recovering lost minerals and crystals.

destructor.name: Destroyer
destructor.description: A true floating fortress. Its sole purpose is the total annihilation of enemy fleets and heavy planetary defenses.

sateliteSolar.name: Solar Satellite
sateliteSolar.description: Simple but effective orbital power platform. Provides constant power to the planet using radiation from the local star.

naveBatalla.name: Battle Ship
naveBatalla.description: The pride of the imperial navy. Equipped with mega-lasers and ion shields, it is capable of withstanding extreme punishment.

colonizador.name: Colony Ship
colonizador.description: A massive vessel equipped with everything needed to establish new colonies on uninhabited planets.

techEnergia.name: Energy Technology
techEnergia.description: Improves the efficiency of all energy systems. It is the fundamental requirement for developing new advanced technologies.

techLaser.name: Laser Technology
techLaser.description: Development of concentrated light systems for weapons and shields. Increases the firepower of light ships and defenses.

techMotores.name: Drive Technology
techMotores.description: Research on chemical propulsion and impulse systems. Significantly increases the speed of all your ships.

techIones.name: Ion Technology
techIones.description: Utilization of charged particles to create disruptive weapons and more resistant shields. Fundamental for medium-class ships.

techHiperespacio.name: Hyperspace Technology
techHiperespacio.description: Allows ships to perform jumps through folded dimensions, drastically reducing interstellar travel time.

techPlasma.name: Plasma Technology
techPlasma.description: The final evolution of thermal weaponry. Generates spheres of ionized matter of immense destructive power.

researchNetwork.name: Intergalactic Research Network
researchNetwork.description: Connects labs from different planets to share data, drastically reducing total research time.

astrophysics.name: Astrophysics
astrophysics.description: Advanced study of the cosmos. Allows colonization of new planets and improves the expedition capacity of your fleets.

missileLauncher.name: Rocket Launcher
missileLauncher.description: Basic and cheap defense that launches kinetic projectiles. Effective against small ships in large quantities.

smallLaser.name: Small Laser
smallLaser.description: A reliable defensive system using concentrated light. Has excellent aim against light fighters.

largeLaser.name: Large Laser
largeLaser.description: Improved version of the small laser with a more powerful capacitor. Capable of piercing heavy cruiser armor.

gaussCannon.name: Gauss Cannon
gaussCannon.description: Electromagnetic accelerator that fires metallic projectiles at hypersonic speeds. Ignores much of enemy shields.

ionCannon.name: Ion Cannon
ionCannon.description: Fires bursts of ions that overload the electronic systems of attacking ships, momentaneously disabling them.

plasmaCannon.name: Plasma Turret
plasmaCannon.description: The deadliest planetary defense. Fires a plasma sphere capable of vaporizing almost any ship with a single impact.

smallShield.name: Small Shield Dome
smallShield.description: Tactical field generator that envelops the planet. Provides an extra layer of protection against minor bombardments.

largeShield.name: Large Shield Dome
largeShield.description: A massive energy shield. Requires an immense amount of energy but can withstand impacts from heavy battleships.

n1.subject: INCURSION DETECTED
n1.message: Long-range sensors have detected a hostile fleet entering sector Sigma-9. Elevating alert level is recommended. Automatic defense protocol initiated. All ships must report to combat stations immediately.

n2.subject: Trade Treaty Proposal
n2.message: The Galactic Federation extends an offer for free trade of Deuterium. We request an immediate audience. Our refineries in the asteroid belt X-99 have surpluses that could benefit your colony.

n3.subject: Research Completed: Impulse Engines V
n3.message: Upgrades to sub-light thrusters have been installed. Fleet speed has increased by 15%. We can now reach outer planets in half the time.

n4.subject: Supply Arrival
n4.message: Cargo convoy N-442 has arrived at the mining colony. Offloading of 50,000 Metal units in progress. Expected completion in 2 standard hours.

n5.subject: Seismic Activity
n5.message: Minor tremors detected in the volcanic sector. Energy production may fluctuate. Reinforcing fusion reactor foundations is recommended.

n6.subject: Welcome, Commander
n6.message: Your assignment to the frontier sector has been confirmed. We expect great things from your administration. The fleet is at your disposal.
